phases.name: Concurrent worktree verification
phases.description: One release slice: establish source ownership, then complete guest placement, invocation resource ownership and durable completion before admitting shared ordinary execution. Exact P1–P5 contracts and the delivery activation/verification notes in feature-delta.md are authoritative; all four consolidated DISTILL reviews are APPROVED.

steps.name: Bind each checkout's source and retained artifacts
criteria: Linked-worktree identity survives branch changes; clone fallback, equal branches and sanitised spellings select disjoint full bindings without adopting legacy caches.
Sync and pull preserve bound source/artifact/evidence complements under checkout exclusion; pull retrieves named evidence after local edits without rebinding.
Invalid discovery, override and full-owner conflicts produce P1's exact typed refusals before foreign mutation; transfer prerequisites never trigger ordinary package installation.
All seven assigned pre-authored identity/transfer cases pass through the real bootstrap in Lima; ordinary command execution retains existing exclusive authority.
steps.implementation_notes: P1; exact contract and typed-error mappings: feature-delta.md. Activate only the seven assigned existing markers; preserve bodies. RED/GREEN: Lima identity fixtures, never Metal. Retain existing exclusive execution until the integrated dependency is complete. TEST PARADIGM (mandatory): Rust unit properties use proptest plus strict state-delta assertions over a declared universe; real-I/O integration/E2E remain examples. Preserve every Contract Shape declaration. See delivery notes for exact activation, commands, scope and ambiguity gates. No mutation testing.

steps.name: Run ordinary verification concurrently with owned guest cleanup
criteria: P2 admission and P5 completion preserve checkout exclusion, controller detachment, one deadline, exclusive maintenance, v1 compatibility and exact command/runner failures; assigned owner tests pass.
Ordinary nextest routes the exact selected ELF, argv, helpers, environment and retries through approved placement; unknown or absent context fails closed; non-Metal execution remains unchanged.
P3 confines native resources and guest test effects to each invocation; P5 drains descendants and cleans only its three roots, preserving every surviving invocation.

All assigned pre-authored bodies, existing qualification transitions and three external drivers pass at their declared boundaries; all semantic errors retain approved typed representations and precedence.
The updated two-worktree capture satisfies AC-1–AC-7 and K1–K3: overlap, exact source/results, zero forbidden physical-kernel deltas, zero completed-run residue and zero survivor changes.
steps.implementation_notes: P2–P5 are one invariant-preserving integration: never release ordinary concurrency before placement, namespace, source and cleanup guarantees are complete. Activate the assigned complete DISTILL bodies without rewriting them. RED: Lima v2 collection case; GREEN: supported Lima fixtures, then implemented concurrent-runner/native proof per delivery notes. TEST PARADIGM (mandatory): Rust unit properties use proptest plus strict state-delta assertions over a declared universe; real-I/O integration/E2E remain examples. Preserve Contract Shape declarations. No mutation testing, old exclusive-runner campaigns or SSH bypass. Exact activation, prerequisite and reviewer gates are in feature-delta.md.
